title: 3.2.0.1 new APK res/q-.apk duplicates many files in res/
symptom: The new APK (3.2.0.1) contains a complete version of the res/ directory with some changes, more than doubling the disk size of the res directory and increasing the APK size by about 10 MB compared to 3.2.0-rc2. The APK size is 66.2 MB vs 55 MB, and download size is 30.5 MB vs 20.9 MB.
cause: The build now includes a spurious APK (q-.apk) into the resources, which is the wear APK, but it's not possible to install it to watch. The change between rc2 and 3.2.0.1 is migration to kts builds, possibly causing this inclusion.
evidence_quote: q-.apk is wear apk but I don't understand why it's included when it's not possible to install it to watch these files do the size of final apk
